changes: Reading promising results remains prompt guidance; query refinement is not blocked merely because URLs exist.
Search is hidden after four actual requests, and per-call guards reject unavailable actions including within batches.

Cached search budget metadata is refreshed without rewriting previous observations.

offline_verification.key_recovery_scenario: Irrelevant first result, refined query, relevant read, supported answer within four scripted model requests.
offline_verification.hard_cap_scenario: Five search calls in one model response execute at most four provider searches; the fifth returns a structured denial while read_url remains available.

limitations: Mocked behavior does not establish live planning or accuracy improvement.
